correctness.rationale: Explicit characteristic-two symbolic identities verify order two, the invariant generators and their relation. The relation is primitive linear in U,V and hence irreducible. Integrality gives dimension four and equality with the generated subalgebra; a degree-two invariant-field extension plus Serre R1/S2 normality proves the complete invariant ring. Exact partial derivatives determine the reduced singular plane and the Jacobian ideal (z^2,t^2,D^2); the quotient is free of rank eight over its singular plane. The singular determinant-quadric fixed locus obstructs conjugacy to any linear involution. The standalone GF2 sparse-polynomial verifier ran successfully. Infinite-field arguments are given in RESULT.md.
